info.title: ServiceGrid IQ Phase 2 Authentication API
info.description: Implemented local authentication subset. SecureSession is used with HTTPS; LocalSession is accepted only in loopback local configuration. Mutations require exact configured Origin and session CSRF token. No bearer-token login or password API. AWS and managed identity deployment remain deferred.
